basic_profile.bio: A recent college graduate in computer science, currently working as a software developer in Austin, Texas. I have a keen interest in gaming, particularly MOBA games like DOTA 2. When I'm not coding, I'm either leveling up my skills or exploring new games. I'm in a relationship with someone who shares my passion for gaming. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends, as my job keeps me busy during weekdays.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught gamer with a focus on mastering strategies and counterplays in DOTA 2. I often watch Twitch streams and YouTube tutorials to improve my gameplay. My knowledge is primarily from personal experience and online resources.
